name: byjustinwu
title: byjustinwu: long-form video journals
summary: Long-form (15-19 min) day-by-day vlogs in 4-7 lowercase chapters. Talking holds long (median 7.4 s, single takes up to 102 s), b-roll runs around 3.5 s, bursts drop to 0.4-1.8 s per shot. Music sits about 12 dB above dialogue and cuts to digital silence under chapter cards. Type is small lowercase sans over b-roll (never over to-camera talking), with huge vertically stretched titles over overlapping textured rectangles at chapter breaks. Graphics pop on and off in single frames and never move; only their fills animate.

jev_questions.instructions: Given this clip's transcript excerpt, speech share, loudness and shot length, which role does it play in a byjustinwu video journal?

options.talking: he speaks to camera or narrates; hold long, cut on pauses
options.broll: scene or action without him addressing the camera; ~3.5 s shots
options.burst: short fragments of one outing that belong in a fast run under music
options.establishing: a wide, exterior or room shot that could open a day or chapter

jev_questions.instructions: Does a new day, place, or phase of the term start at this clip, compared with the previous clip?
jev_questions.true: a new chapter or date stamp belongs here
jev_questions.false: same day and place as before

jev_questions.instructions: At this chapter break, which transition fits: a full card, or a date stamp over the first shot?

options.card: a new city, job, event or phase; the chapter deserves a title
options.stamp: a new day in the same place or thread

jev_questions.instructions: Should the music bed keep playing under this talking passage?
jev_questions.true: light, walking-and-talking, or banter; keep a ducked bed
jev_questions.false: reflective, confessional or detailed; let it play dry

jev_questions.instructions: Which spoken line best opens the video by saying what this period was like? Options are the candidate lines, keyed by clip and time.
